name: Real Estate WhatsApp AI Agent (local n8n + Ollama)

parameters.content:
## Setup (see README)
1. Edit the **Config** node (sheet ID, phone number ID, admin email, Ollama URL/model).
2. Assign credentials: Google Sheets, Gmail, and *WhatsApp Cloud API Token* (Header Auth: `Authorization` = `Bearer <token>`).
3. Activate the workflow, then use the **Production** webhook URL (path `/webhook/whatsapp`) in Meta.

## Meta webhook verification
GET requests with `hub.challenge` are answered here. The POST webhook replies 200 immediately so Meta never retries because Ollama is slow.

## Load context
One read per tab (Google Sheets). Phone numbers are matched as digits only.

## Brain
Ollama extracts intent/fields (JSON). **Resolve Action** is a deterministic state machine: n8n validates everything, Ollama never writes to the sheet.

## Booking
Duplicate + slot-conflict check, save appointment, then two Gmail notifications. Email failures are recorded in the sheet but never block the booking or the WhatsApp reply.

## Reply + persist
WhatsApp message(s) go out first, then ConversationState and Customers are upserted.
